Nutrient concentrations in Table 1 are expressed as % for N and P, and mg/kg for Cu, Mn, Zn - units differ by element

Figures 2 and 3 report resorption EFFICIENCY (a derived percentage), not raw concentrations - these are NOT the primary outcome for dilution effect analysis
Figures 4 and 5 report resorption PROFICIENCY (terminal senesced leaf concentration) - these could be extracted as senesced leaf mineral data if needed but are secondary to green leaf data

Values in parentheses are SE with n=3 plots per treatment. Units: N and P are in %, Cu/Mn/Zn are in mg/kg - note unit conversion needs (% to mg/kg: multiply by 10000). Bold values in Table 1 indicate significantly greater mean - note this can be in either ambient or elevated direction. Recommend treating each species-year combination as an independent observation.
